analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see for 2 consecutive sessions. RSI at 34.6 entering oversold, MACD histogram at -0.4269 continues weakness. Volume ratio at 1.49 surged on decline, but weekly ADX at 17.1 indicates a non-trending phase, suggesting short-term drops as potentially reversible shocks. Positioned at 28.5% of 52-week low. Lower Low pattern persists with 5-day low at $49.38 and 20-day low at $49.38. Current price $51.81 nears swing support at $51.61. With a stop loss 1.3x ATR ($5.74) from current price, a risk-reward ratio of 1.5+ is achievable. Consider buying only after RSI recovers above 50 and MACD confirms a golden cross.
